preconditions.description: Both inputs `a` and `b` must be strings.

postconditions.expression: all(c in a or c in b for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: Every character in the output `return_value` must appear in at least one of the input strings `a` or `b`.

postconditions.expression: all(c not in b for c in return_value if c in a) and all(c not in a for c in return_value if c in b)
postconditions.description: The output `return_value` contains only characters that are not common to both strings: characters from `a` not in `b` followed by characters from `b` not in `a`.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len([c for c in a if c not in b]) + len([c for c in b if c not in a])
postconditions.description: The length of `return_value` is the sum of characters in `a` not present in `b` and characters in `b` not present in `a`.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join([c for c in a if c not in b]) + ''.join([c for c in b if c not in a])
postconditions.description: The output `return_value` is the concatenation of characters from `a` not in `b` followed by characters from `b` not in `a`, preserving their original order.
